description: Human-readable health REPORT for a finished ZPL label, with a 0-100 score: sectioned findings (syntax, size/DPI, orientation, barcodes, fonts, graphics memory, job behaviour); sections that cannot be assessed say so and are excluded from the score. Use it to review or explain a label to a person; for a quick pass/fail check while editing, use zpl_validate instead.

dpmm.description: Printer density (8 = 203 dpi). The size/DPI section is scored against it — pass the real value.

height_in.description: Label height in inches; same role as width_in.

width_in.description: Label width in inches; fields outside it are reported.

name: explain_zpl
title: Explain ZPL health report
